comment: Offset sets the SVS profile grouping to call: 0 = SVS 1-99, 1 = 101-199, 2 = 201-299, etc (ie S1_profile.rt4, S102_profile.rt4). Preset 7 on offset 0 sends SVS NEW INPUT=7; the same preset on offset 1 sends SVS NEW INPUT=107. Use the Extron LAN IP (no http://). If mDNS fails, set host to http://<donutshop-ip>.
